name: tacraft-sociality/concourse
description: Concourse — a clean three-column community theme for Flarum 2. A left sidebar with your tag tree on every page, compact discussion rows with like and reply counts, and a right column with your profile card, Top Contributors and any widgets you add.

suggest.flarum/tags: The tag tree in the left sidebar and the tag page header.
suggest.flarum/likes: Like counts on discussion rows, and Top Contributors ranked by likes received.
suggest.flarum/subscriptions: The Following link in the sidebar.
suggest.ernestdefoe/backdrop: The member's own cover on the profile card, framed as on their profile.
suggest.sycho/flarum-profile-cover: The member's own cover picture on the profile card.
suggest.fof/forum-widgets-core: The profile card and Top Contributors are offered as widgets.
suggest.ernestdefoe/wardrobe: Run Concourse next to other themes and let members choose.

scripts-descriptions.test:setup: Sets up a database for use with integration tests. Execute this only once.
